behavior_change: Both curve classes expose protected init via their shared core. Mismatched weights now raise Standard_DimensionMismatch after pole/closure update and weight resize, retaining prior rationality and caches on failure. Former code silently accepted unequal lengths and reset rationality early.
scope_limits: Native uninitialized floating-point weights after a failed resize are not read by the fixture. Rust initializes those slots deterministically.
Supplemental Rust tests verify derivative-cache invalidation on success and preservation on failure; the exact native receipt verifies public geometry/weight/error state.
This does not establish configuration-wide or complete toolkit API parity.

validation.strict_clippy: cargo clippy -p rustycad-tkg2d -p rustycad-tkg3d --all-targets -- -D warnings: passed
